item.title: Rainfall Advisory #VISPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #VISPRSD
Issued at 11:06 AM 17 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #NegrosOccidental(Binalbagan), #Palawan(Taytay, Agutaya, Cuyo, Magsaysay, Dumaran, Araceli) and #Antique(Caluya) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #NegrosOccidental(CityOfHimamaylan), #OccidentalMindoro, #Palawan(Busuanga, Coron, Culion, ElNido and Linapacan) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
